notes: "HUANDENG is an editing workflow for scientific presentations. It brings together a visual editor, a portable working project and access for AI agents. It began with my experience preparing lab meetings: I wanted help with repetitive work while retaining the judgment, original material and a clear place to make the next edit. We will locate a page, preserve its intent and evidence, inspect a change and turn the pages into a talk."

designIntent.purpose: HUANDENG is an editing workflow for scientific presentations
keep: Keep actual product captures, original scientific data/assets, attribution and the demonstrated function. Do not fragment ordinary prose into a fake table.
designIntent.requestedChange: Explain the product and its use; interpret the founder’s account to choose the emphasis.
